All 5 backend pytest tests pass; UI flow verified end-to-end (Reg Template downloads correct filename; uploading a 2-row XLSX shows Registered=2, Skipped=0 in modal).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py _register_one_bulk_row: duplicate check uses $or on email+phone — if phone column is missing but email is present, empty-string phone could match another empty-string phone doc. Currently guarded by 'missing_required' check requiring both, so safe.

AdminDashboard.jsx bulkRegisterScholarship: modal shows 'Admit Cards Sent' = data.registered, which conflates queued vs actually sent (email/whatsapp are background tasks that may fail silently). Acceptable for UX but worth logging.
bulk-register endpoint caps errors at 50 — good defensive practice; frontend does not currently display the errors list, only counts. Consider surfacing errors[] in the modal for admin visibility.
seed_data_creation: Each backend test creates unique TEST_ scholarship_applications rows with timestamp-based email/phone; not cleaned up (approved applications remain in DB for WATH). UI test also added 2 real approved applications.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend bulk-register endpoint is fully verified for empty-row / duplicate / missing_required flows. WATH campaign id = 1ed94009-d949-4504-b291-68e3571a5a44. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10.py can be re-run anytime; it self-generates unique data per run.
rca of the issue: Original 'skipped duplicate 999' bug root cause: openpyxl's ws.iter_rows returns trailing rows (with None cells) up to ws.max_row, which reflects any cell ever touched by Excel. The prior implementation counted every None-only row as a failed row and reported it as skipped. Fix (verified working): server now `continue`s on any row where every cell is None/blank, decrements total_rows accordingly, and reports registered/skipped/total_rows/errors accurately. Confirmed by test_bulk_register_valid_rows_with_trailing_empty (2 valid + 500 empty trailing rows → registered=2, skipped=0, total_rows=2, errors=[]).
